verified_improvements: BoundaryIndex and strict_prefix now exclude later rows before validating the retained earlier prefix; the clean-prefix versus nonmonotonic-suffix regression passes.
The measured preserved-v1 fixture now returns CASH because held-asset cash-filter precedence is restored before winner selection.
A score_at primitive now materializes raw returns, volatility, score, cutoff, retained identity tuple, and observation count for each asset.
Exact stationary-bootstrap, multiplicity-registry, fold-constant, governance-evidence, and quarantine-action primitives now exist.
The live model itself truthfully reports the implementation is partial and remains blocked.
remaining_material_failures: run_clock still accepts caller-supplied desired targets, does not calculate decisions from post-fill state, assigns cutoff equal to fill-vector timestamp, and leaves interval_return and wealth at their default values. It is not a complete execution or accounting trace.

build_period_run calculates desired targets separately and then calls the legacy external-target run_clock, so scoring identities and true maximum information cutoffs are discarded from the returned trace. It neither derives price returns nor invokes self-financing rebalance accounting.

No complete quarantine state machine exists. quarantine_action is only a three-field primitive; there is no cash segment split, priced liquidation execution, fail-closed unpriced liquidation path, 150-session recovery transition, or regime reset in the period runner.

No aggregate and four-fold evaluation runner exists. DEVELOPMENT_FOLDS is a constant only; fold initialization, warmup, strict fold state, trial/stress independence, and fold outputs are not executed.

score_at checks monotonic event timestamps independently per asset but does not require the BTC and ETH observations at a common index to describe the same synchronized complete session, does not enforce daily continuity, and is not integrated into a trace that retains both assets' exact input identities and common cutoff.

The independent oracle remains partial. oracle_clock does not emit the production DecisionTrace schema or independently compute score identities, common cutoff, exact row identities, quarantine/recovery/folds, stationary bootstrap, DSR/PBO, multiplicity extraction, regime labels, nineteen-gate map, or terminal cash reconciliation.

The multiplicity primitive has no frozen 49-slot constructor bound to the preregistered names, artifact paths, byte hashes, JSON pointers, extraction conversions, and append-only 56/35/21 transition; no substantive test exercises it.

Most exact-named tests remain the same insufficient assertions identified by repair-1 validation. Examples include checking only the seven-trial constant instead of the 36-entry allowlist/source commit; a vector count instead of 150 recovery transitions; one boundary instead of all four folds; object identities instead of seven independent simulations; a numeric range instead of exact DSR recomputation; PBO instead of stationary bootstrap; default wealth instead of derived non-performance evidence; and cash constants instead of derived holdout/capital/GPU/mining evidence.
No comprehensive exhaustive independent v1 decision-parity grid was added; only the previously failing held-asset case received a new regression test.
